description: This file provides runtime environment definitions and utility functions for logging, error handling, stdout writing, and process control within the project. It includes type definitions for runtime environments, functions for conditional logging/output based on environment variables, and a default runtime implementation that manages process exit and I/O operations.

methods.name: function shouldEmitRuntimeLog(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): boolean { shouldEmitRuntimeLog
methods.description: Determines whether runtime logs should be emitted based on environment variables.

methods.name: function shouldEmitRuntimeStdout(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): boolean { shouldEmitRuntimeStdout
methods.description: Determines whether stdout output should be emitted based on environment variables.

methods.name: function isPipeClosedError(err: unknown): boolean { isPipeClosedError
methods.description: Checks if an error is related to a closed pipe, such as EPIPE or EIO.

methods.name: function hasRuntimeOutputWriter( hasRuntimeOutputWriter
methods.description: Type guard that checks if the runtime environment supports writing stdout and JSON output.

methods.name: function writeStdout(value: string): void { writeStdout
methods.description: Writes a string to standard output, appending a newline if not present.

methods.name: function createRuntimeIo(): Pick<OutputRuntimeEnv, "log" | "error" | "writeStdout" | "writeJson"/ createRuntimeIo
methods.description: Creates an object implementing core runtime methods: log, error, writeStdout, and writeJson.

methods.name: export function createNonExitingRuntime(): OutputRuntimeEnv { createNonExitingRuntime
methods.description: Creates a runtime environment that throws an error instead of exiting the process.

methods.name: export function writeRuntimeStdout(runtime: RuntimeEnv | OutputRuntimeEnv, value: string): void / writeRuntimeStdout
methods.description: Writes output to the runtime's stdout, or logs if not supported.

methods.name: export function writeRuntimeJson( writeRuntimeJson
methods.description: Outputs JSON data via the runtime's writeJson method or logs the serialized object.

ctags.name: maybeMockedLog
ctags.pattern: /^  const maybeMockedLog = console.log as unknown as { mock?: unknown };$/

ctags.name: writeRuntimeStdout
ctags.pattern: /^export function writeRuntimeStdout(runtime: RuntimeEnv | OutputRuntimeEnv, value: string): void /
